description: "I believe religious liberty means exactly what it says. It protects the Christian, the Muslim, the Jew, the Hindu, the Buddhist, the Sikh, people of all other faiths, and those who profess no faith at all. It protects the faith I profess, and it protects the conscience of people whose beliefs I may profoundly disagree with."
paid_for_by: Paid for by Joshua Irby Behind the Platform Personal Reflections “I don’t see sides—I see people
title: A Constitutional Commitment to Religious Freedom
